title: Rooms Usage — payload
description: A room's owner reads how much each member who has added files is using, against their allowance. Authorized by the room's own credentials: a chain conferring `admin` at the room's scope.

roomId.description: The room's identifier. The host verifies the presentation against credentials issued by this identifier.

presentation.description: Must confer the `admin` action at this room's scope.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation from a previous response's `nextCursor`. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Most entries to return. The host chooses when omitted, and may return fewer.

member.description: The member's DID: the subject at the room end of the chains they presented when uploading. Uploads by a member's agents are counted here, under the member.

limits.description: The limits that apply to this member in this room: their override if one is set, else the room's per-member default.

overridden.description: True when `limits` is an override set for this member rather than the room's default.

lastUploadAt.description: When this member last committed a blob in the room.

members.description: One entry per member who holds or has reserved storage in the room, or holds an override. Not a roster: a member who has never added a file does not appear, because the host has never been told about them.

nextCursor.description: Present exactly when more entries remain.
